2607.13285.title: Harness Handbook: Making Evolving Agent Harnesses Readable,Navigable, and Editable
2607.13285.paper_summary: The capability of a modern AI agent depends not only on its foundation model but also on its harness, which constructs prompts, manages state, invokes tools, and coordinates execution. As models, APIs, environments, and requirements evolve, the harness must be continually modified. Before such a change can be made, a developer or coding agent must identify all code locations that implement the target behavior. This is difficult because production harnesses are large, tightly coupled, and behaviorally distributed, while modification requests describe what the system should do and repositories are organized by files and modules. Code search, repository indexing, and long-context processing ease inspection, but still leave this behavior-to-code mapping to be recovered by hand. Behavior localization is therefore a central bottleneck in harness evolution. We introduce the Harness Handbook, a behavior-centric representation synthesized automatically from a harness codebase via static analysis and LLM-assisted structuring, linking each behavior to its corresponding source. We also introduce Behavior-Guided Progressive Disclosure (BGPD), which guides agents from high-level behaviors to relevant implementation details and verifies candidate locations against the current source. On diverse modification requests from two open-source harnesses, Handbook-Assisted planning improves behavior localization and edit-plan quality while using fewer planner tokens, with the largest gains on scattered sites, rarely executed paths, and cross-module interactions. Evolving complex agentic systems thus depends not only on generating edits, but also on determining where those edits should be made.
2607.13285.paper_summary_zh: 現代 AI 代理的能力不僅依賴於其基礎模型，還依賴於其工具，該工具構建提示、管理狀態、調用工具並協調執行。隨著模型、API、環境和需求的演變，工具必須不斷修改。在進行此類更改之前，開發者或編碼代理必須識別所有實現目標行為的代碼位置。這是困難的，因為生產工具龐大、緊密耦合且行為分散，而修改請求描述系統應該做什麼，存儲庫則按文件和模塊組織。代碼搜索、存儲庫索引和長上下文處理簡化了檢查，但仍然需要手動恢復這種行為與代碼的映射。因此，行為定位是工具演變中的一個核心瓶頸。我們介紹了《工具手冊》，這是一種行為中心的表示，通過靜態分析和 LLM 輔助結構自動從工具代碼庫中合成，將每個行為鏈接到其相應的來源。我們還介紹了行為引導的漸進式披露（BGPD），它指導代理從高級行為到相關實現細節，並根據當前源驗證候選位置。在來自兩個開源工具的多樣化修改請求中，手冊輔助規劃提高了行為定位和編輯計劃的質量，同時使用了更少的規劃者標記，對於分散的站點、很少執行的路徑和跨模塊互動的增益最大。因此，發展複雜的代理系統不僅依賴於生成編輯，還依賴於確定這些編輯應該進行的位置。
